note: Per-cell cost basis. Subscription billing only: USD is the booked value, not a charge; the real constraint is the shared quota and the model mix. Nothing here is measured for these kits: the pilot measures it.

haiku.basis: one measured Haiku cell, evals/skill-onoff/README.md findings-batch pilot (rolekit-probe 2026-11-05 section 4.3; the same README warns that summing every result row gives 0.0433)

sonnet_high.basis: findings-batch T1/T2 two-round cell, Sonnet estimate (rolekit-probe 4.3)

second_weak_seat.basis: no recorded cost for a non-Claude cheap seat; the Haiku rate is used as a stand-in and the cells run on that seat's own subscription, not the Claude quota

caveats: implementer, debugger and explorer cells run tool loops; no recorded per-cell cost exists for a Haiku tool-loop cell, so the Haiku rate may be low for those roles; the pilot reports the real value per role and the verdict rule compares it with this table
--max-budget-usd is checked after a call, so a cell can overshoot by one model call (rolekit-probe 4.3)
